comment: Phase 0 rehearsal testbed (C380/C382/C384) — inner-Buckle upstream rows.
inherit_defaults:false is load-bearing: the pool is EXACTLY this row —
no committed ladder underneath, so fail-closed-with-zero-fallback is
structural, not policy. Hostname `stub` is the compose service name on
the internal testbed network (vllm-stub serves 8190 there); the e2e
spec writes its own temp rows with dynamic loopback ports instead of
reading this file. Neutral ids only: the private rollout doc maps
test-model to the pilot model id.
Env law: STUB_TOKEN names an env var read at request time — the value
never lives in this file or any committed file.
